title: InsightOps
tagline: We developed plugin-eigenavs using the Dune API to track TVL, AVS metadata, and operator data by address. It provides details like names, logos, and social media links, while tracking the relationships between operators and AVS for deeper insights
description:
InsightOps is a comprehensive platform designed to provide in-depth tracking of operators, Active Verification Services (AVS), and their associated activities. As part of our platform, we developed a plugin named plugin-eigenavs, leveraging multiple tools and APIs, including the Dune API, to gather and present vital data on the blockchain ecosystem. This plugin tracks and displays crucial data such as:

TVL (Total Value Locked) data for both AVS and operators
AVS Metadata by address, including details like AVS Name, Functionality, Logo, Twitter URL, and Website URL
Operator Metadata by address, showcasing Operator Name, Functionality, Logo, Twitter URL, and Website URL
Tracks the relationship between operators and AVS, offering deeper insights into their interactions and dependencies
how_its_made:
We have made eigenavs plugin using Eliza that tracks all the details regarding the Avs and operator and the relation between them . We have used DUNE Api to made this plugin . We have also deployed our character on autonome as well .

This plugin will track all the activities in the eigen layer ecosystem . By integrating this you can track tvl in different categories , for how long avs are operating and much more. We want to create a single place to track avs , operator and much more in eigen layer ecosystem
